name: Slice-based Volume Rendering using Pixel Bender
aliases: Slice-based volume rendering using Pixel Bender
definition: A real-time volume rendering technique using view-aligned slices and a static 3D texture (set of cross sections), implemented via Pixel Bender shaders.
summary: Slice-based Volume Rendering using Pixel Bender is a real-time technique that renders volume data directly via view-aligned slices and Pixel Bender shaders, avoiding isosurface generation to enable translucent cross-sections.
